# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Promoted the remaining hardcoded molt knobs into named shrimp runtime/species parameters, including failed-molt accumulation increase/recovery, failed-molt stress blending, and the poor-condition/instability diagnostic thresholds. I wired those fields through invariant validation, preset parsing/materialization, and `neocaridina_davidi.toml`, then updated molt failure reporting so marginal misses no longer default to `PoorCondition`: failures now surface an explicit `MarginalFailure` cause when no concrete threshold trips and include the relevant score or critical-GH gap in the event summary. I also tightened the mineral/reproduction regressions by making the 1000-hour soft-water integration use explicit Ca/Mg-deficient source chemistry, adding coverage that the new accumulation/diagnostic parameters change behavior, sampling stable-tank chemistry hourly instead of once per day, and isolating lingering instability as the readiness suppressor in the post-swing reproduction test.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Parameterized the remaining failed-molt accumulation, stress-blend, and diagnostic-threshold constants on `ShrimpRuntimeParams`, then threaded them through invariants, preset loading, scenario materialization, and shipped shrimp data.
2. [Completed] Updated molt failure diagnostics to avoid misleading fallback attribution by emitting `MarginalFailure` when no specific threshold fires and by including score/critical-GH details in the event summary.
3. [Completed] Strengthened the mineral and reproduction regressions so the soft-water survival case exercises GH plus Ca/Mg deficiency explicitly, stable-tank chemistry checks capture intra-day peaks, and post-swing readiness suppression is isolated to lingering instability.
4. [Completed] Ran formatting plus targeted and full-suite regression coverage across `tank_core`, `tank_data`, and `tank_scenarios` to confirm the amendments end to end.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_data`
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios`
- `cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture`

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
